changes.name: SkyCoinSystem
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local map=workspace:WaitForChild("SkyboundMap")

local old=map:FindFirstChild("SkyCoinPickups")
if old then old:Destroy() end

local folder=Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name="SkyCoinPickups"
folder.Parent=map

local function setupPlayer(player)
 local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
 if not stats then
  stats=Instance.new("Folder")
  stats.Name="leaderstats"
  stats.Parent=player
 end
 local coins=stats:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins")
 if not coins then
  coins=Instance.new("IntValue")
  coins.Name="SkyCoins"
  coins.Value=0
  coins.Parent=stats
 end
end

for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do setupPlayer(p) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer)

local positions={
 Vector3.new(-28,62,-10),Vector3.new(-16,62,-25),Vector3.new(0,62,-34),
 Vector3.new(18,62,-25),Vector3.new(30,62,-8),Vector3.new(28,62,18),
 Vector3.new(12,62,30),Vector3.new(-10,62,31),Vector3.new(-29,62,18),
 Vector3.new(0,62,4),Vector3.new(15,62,8),Vector3.new(-15,62,8)
}

local function makeCoin(index,pos)
 local coin=Instance.new("Part")
 coin.Name="SkyCoin"..index
 coin.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
 coin.Size=Vector3.new(3,3,3)
 coin.Position=pos
 coin.Anchored=true
 coin.CanCollide=false
 coin.CanTouch=true
 coin.Material=Enum.Material.Neon
 coin.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,215,55)
 coin.Parent=folder

 local light=Instance.new("PointLight")
 light.Color=coin.Color
 light.Brightness=1.5
 light.Range=10
 light.Parent=coin

 local available=true
 coin.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
  if not available then return end
  local character=hit.Parent
  local player=character and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
  if not player then return end
  local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
  local coins=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins")
  if not coins then return end
  available=false
  coins.Value+=1
  coin.Transparency=1
  light.Enabled=false
  coin.CanTouch=false
  task.delay(8,function()
   if coin.Parent then
    coin.Transparency=0
    light.Enabled=true
    coin.CanTouch=true
    available=true
   end
  end)
 end)
end

for i,pos in ipairs(positions) do makeCoin(i,pos) end

print("Skybound collectible coins loaded")
